clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind Keep, Margulf Blaggon’s book on metallurgy has been lent to Northshire Abbey for copying.

Margulf Blaggon wrote about the practical and theoretical sides of metallurgy. Milton Sheaf cared for the volume in the Royal Library of Stormwind Keep. The library lent it to Northshire Abbey, where Brother Paxton copied it by hand for his own collection. Paxton’s work took far longer than expected, and Brother Kristoff waited anxiously in Cathedral Square for the book to return to the city.
